snapshots.name: Niels
snapshots.subtitle: A dreaming, restless young Dane
snapshots.body: Raised on family stories and a mother's poetic imagination, he grows up torn between the pull of art and a hard-won, unsentimental atheism. His search for something to believe in shapes every attachment he forms as he grows older.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Bartholine
snapshots.subtitle: Niels's mother
snapshots.body: Romantic and given to daydreaming over old ballads and stories, she fills her son's childhood with an imaginative inner life that outlasts her own disappointments. Her early influence on Niels runs deeper than either of them quite realizes.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Erik
snapshots.subtitle: Niels's charming, talented childhood friend
snapshots.body: Gifted as a painter and effortlessly likable in a way Niels never quite manages, he grows up alongside Niels as a kind of golden counterpart. His artistic promise and his personal discipline do not always keep pace with each other.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Fennimore
snapshots.subtitle: A vivacious young woman connected to both Niels and Erik
snapshots.body: Warm, impulsive, and drawn to whichever of the two friends seems most alive to her at the time, she becomes entangled with both of them at different points. Her choices set much of the story's later course.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Edele
snapshots.subtitle: Niels's cousin
snapshots.body: Beautiful and admired, she is the object of Niels's youthful infatuation during a visit to his uncle's estate. Her health becomes a source of quiet worry as the story goes on.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Mrs. Boye
snapshots.subtitle: An older widow Niels becomes involved with
snapshots.body: Worldly and self-possessed in a way that unsettles the younger men around her, she draws Niels into an intense, complicated attachment in Copenhagen. Her influence on his development is considerable, and not entirely comfortable.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Gerda
snapshots.subtitle: A young woman who later becomes close to Niels
snapshots.body: Gentle and devoted, she offers Niels a kind of quiet domestic happiness that his earlier attachments never provided. Her simple faith stands in constant, unspoken contrast to his own convictions.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Bigum
snapshots.subtitle: An acquaintance from Niels's circle
snapshots.body: A recurring presence among the friends, students, and artists who pass through Niels's life in Copenhagen. His opinions and company mark one of the social worlds Niels moves through.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.
